benchmark: historical author B=0.1. Not B_cri. The |J|-max, Fiedler, union, quarter-pi, classical-popcount, repulsion-escape, and QAOA-depth rounds are not rerun and their verdicts are not edited.
hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i, J iid Normal(0,1), SeedSequence([20261115, N, k])
k_not_used: 0..129 were used in earlier rounds, except that k=100 and k=101 are the round-1 held-out instances and are not used. 142 and above stay unused.
forbidden: an energy-only union of two packings
a pi/4 or pi/2 shell displacement
using fidelity or a quantum eigenvector to score, start, or select the claimed state

families.nodata: standard shared-gamma search, interleaved, present only so K can nest. Not the claim.
families.K: standard shared-gamma search, interleaved, present only so KM can nest. Not the claim.
families.KM: original shared-gamma KM, interleaved triples, 3+3L, round-4 starts only. Energy-only selection is the claim.
families.qaoa: independent gamma_l and beta_l, 2L, round-4 starts, repeats 0 and 1. This is the historical comparator.

packing: interleaved triples [[a, a+N/3, a+2N/3] for a in 0..N/3). The same partition at every layer and at every N. FK = J@J with zero diagonal, rms-normalized. FM = block means on these triples.
architecture: cavity X frame, one gamma, one thetaK, one thetaM, three shell angles per layer, same UcX at every layer. QAOA is the usual independent-angle circuit.
box: every linear coefficient and each QAOA gamma in [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J]; shells and beta in [-2pi, 2pi]
optimizer: L-BFGS-B, analytic adjoint gradient, true energy, no classical penalty

seeds.note: Standard starts use the round-4 integer prefixes. family_index is the position in family_order, so KM is 2 and qaoa is 3. k=100 and k=101 are not used. No new random starts are drawn.

continuation: Zhou interpolation, time-rescaled shared coefficients, perturbations 0.1 and 0.3, two ramps, and for QAOA the best append-zero plus N(0,0.05). No third repeat.
selection: lowest true energy. Ties: lower repeat, then label. No ground state, eigenvector of H, E0, or fidelity in the starts or in this selection.
primary_metric: F_sub within 1e-6 of E0, all N, computed after selection on the energy-selected state

confirmation.pass_at_N: wins > losses, and the bootstrap 95 percent interval for the median fidelity difference has lower endpoint > 0
confirmation.overall_confirmed: all three N pass on the energy-only column
confirmation.overall_partial: N=6 passes on the energy-only column and at least one of N=9 or N=12 does not
confirmation.overall_not_confirmed: N=6 does not pass on the energy-only column
confirmation.overall_incomplete: any N has fewer than 8 instances with both repeats complete

diagnosis.role: a second column on the same stored starts. It does not rewrite the energy-only pass rule and it is not the verdict.
diagnosis.pool: optimized KM starts at L=6 from repeats 0 and 1 whose true energy is at most the energy-only QAOA energy plus energy_legal_tol
diagnosis.pick: highest F_sub in the pool. Ties: lower energy, then lower repeat, then label. If the pool is empty, the diagnostic state is the energy-only KM state.
diagnosis.differs: the diagnostic state has F_sub larger than the energy-only state by more than 1e-6, or its energy differs by more than 1e-8
diagnosis.diagnostic_pass: the same win rule, equal depth, equal search, with the diagnostic state in place of the energy-only KM state
diagnosis.selection_limited: the energy-only column does not pass and the diagnostic column does pass
diagnosis.reading_claim_passes: Energy-only KM clears the historical comparator on this sample. The diagnostic state also clears it.
diagnosis.reading_selection_limited: Energy-only selection discarded a KM state that is energy-legal against QAOA and clears the fidelity rule. The miss on this sample is the selection rule.
diagnosis.reading_no_alternative: Post-selection inside the joint-energy window does not change the selected state. The miss is the energy minimizer, not a discarded energy-legal alternative.
diagnosis.reading_alternative_still_fails: A different energy-legal KM state was available. It still does not clear the comparator.

descriptive_unrestricted.role: not a comparator and not part of either pass bit
descriptive_unrestricted.state: the L=6 KM start, among both repeats, with the highest F_sub. Ties: lower energy, then lower repeat, then label.
descriptive_unrestricted.reported: median F_sub gain over the energy-only state, median energy gap above the energy-only state, and the count of instances whose unrestricted state is not the energy-only state

secondary_equal_param.role: reported only, not part of the verdict

job_order: k ascending, within k N=12 then 9 then 6. Within a job, repeats r=0 then r=1, and within a repeat nodata, K, KM, qaoa, depth 1 then 6.
